messages:
Dana: Quick alignment: propose a single 'capacity hint' line in per-route saved views summarizing latency tier, token burn, and fallback eligibility. Keep it compact with an expand for details.

Omar: server should be authoritative. Console calls GET /saved-queries/{id}/capacity-hint and receives a small canonical hint object. Prefer id-only for deterministic results.

Nina: agree id-only, but add a preview endpoint that accepts filters for pre-save UX. Also we need a confidence bucket based on sample_count: low/med/high.

Omar: include model_variant_id and rollout_tag in the hint so UI knows when it's stale. For private deployments return data_source:"local-agent" in response.

Dana: UX: pill text example "~120ms · ~260 tok/call · fallback:redwood-lite · (low confidence)". Expand shows last_sample_at and a Refresh CTA. Avoid alarmist language for quotas.

kevin-bot: feature flag created: feature.console.capacity_hint (alpha internal -> canary).

Nina: action items: Omar spec API + migration, Dana mock UI copy, I'll define telemetry events (hint_shown/hint_refreshed).
